Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The Journey with the <color=#F7BE45>[Visitor]</color>, Yoo Mina, began.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>「来訪者」</color>ミナとの救援の旅が始まった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 与<color=#F7BE45>「访客」</color>刘米娜的旅程开始了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 與<color=#F7BE45>「訪客」</color>劉米娜的旅程開始了。
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>Besucherin</color> Yumina und die Reise haben begonnen.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A jornada com Yumina, a <color=#F7BE45>[Visitante]</color>, começou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>ผู้มาเยือน</color>อย่างยูมิน่า การเดินทางได้เริ่มต้นขึ้นแล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Perjalanan bersama Yumina, <color=#F7BE45>[Sang Pengunjung]</color>, telah dimulai.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[Người ghé thăm]</color> là Yumina, hành trình của chúng ta đã bắt đầu.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[विज़िटर]</color> यूमिना के साथ यात्रा शुरू हो गई।
